received_works.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your previous works!

I would like to request an image of two original characters for a fan-made story based on the “NARUTO” series. One character is new and has no reference art. The character’s name is Kobayashi Jun (小林 淳). He is the teacher to Kenzo, Shion and Momoka who you have previously drawn. He died in battle long ago.

The image I would like to request is of Momoka, who you have drawn previously (https://files.catbox.moe/gu3fgr.png) and Jun. The setting is a collapsed cavern, far underground and in a spiritual realm that challenges her personality flaws. Momoka is alone, injured, afraid and above all she is angry at herself for several bad decisions she made earlier. Momoka is being given advice by the spirit of her dead teacher, Jun, who can only speak to her because she is in a spiritual realm. She does not know if he is real or a hallucination. 

The pose I would like to use is similar to this: https://files.catbox.moe/5mv2l1.png.

Momoka is looking down. She has tears in her eyes and is injured, and her clothing is damaged. Her appearance is the same as in our previous picture (ex. wavy burn-scars on her body, she has a forehead protector somewhere). You can choose to include her weapons somewhere in the picture (ex. kunai or bow) if it looks better, or you can ignore them. They are not required. Momoka's facial expression is one of self-hatred or regret.

Jun's appearance: 6 feet 4 inches. Brown eyes. Muscular and wide, with very very large arms. His age is in the 50s. He has short-medium hair and a full beard, which are black with significant gray hairs. He has some scars from his various battles. He dresses in black with gold trim, and has a gray scarf. He has a satchel / pouch for his equipment and a brown belt. A close visual reference would be: https://files.catbox.moe/km0dvw.jpg. Jun's hair and beard would have more gray hairs than the reference picture. As always, he should not have zippers or anything beyond clothing that would be found in the 1700s.

Jun's personality: Kind and caring.

Jun is placing either one hand on Momoka's shoulder, or both hands on her shoulders. Select whichever one looks better. I believe one hand will allow some of his facial features to be more visible. Since Jun is a spirit, he can look somewhat ethereal. For example, he can be partially wavy, or have particle effects around his body. I think it would make for a great effect if his face is partially shaded, or if not all of his face or body are visible due to the viewing angle. He is facing somewhat away from the viewer. This is because he is dead. It adds some sense of mystery to the picture.

Background: Deep underground in a cavern, with dim lighting. There are several rows of candles and funeral incense as the only source of lighting. In the background, there are multiple small single-leg tables (ex. https://files.catbox.moe/crypj2.png) made of sapphire, obsidian, and silver stone. Upon the tables are various funeral urns. At the borders of the image it is dark, to show they are surrounded by darkness. This represents the various dark monsters waiting outside of this room.

The atmosphere is a moment of comfort being given from a long-dead teacher to his student, in a dark and terrible situation. This brief reprieve is what eventually allows Momoka to sort out her feelings, recover and escape.

You can change any details freely as you like to better capture this atmosphere. 

Thanks as always for your time!!

初めまして。
Yuliさんの素敵なイラストに心惹かれ、依頼させていただきました。
人生初の依頼ですので至らぬ点があるかもしれませんがよろしくお願いいたします。

【リクエスト内容】
Vsingerでヴァイオリニストの天羽音みらんさんのイラストをお願いします。
構図やポーズなどは、描きやすいようにして頂けますと幸いです。
春が感じられるような明るい雰囲気だとうれしいです。

【資料】
https://lit.link/miranamahane
https://x.com/AmahaneMiran

【要望】
・服装は、お任せいたします。服装のどこかに薔薇をあしらっていただけると嬉しいです。
・頭の角と周りのメリーゴーランドのような王冠をお願いします。
・描写範囲は全身を描いていただけましたら幸いです。
・背景あり/なしの差分をいただけましたらとても嬉しいです。

【使用用途】
・SNS(X)に掲載
・天羽音みらんさんのYouTubeチャンネル（収益化済み）の動画/配信サムネイルでの使用
※使用する際、トリミング等の調整をさせていただく場合があります。

ご検討いただけましたら幸いです。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

Hello,
Thank you for your previous works!
I would like to request an image of another original character for a fan-made story based on the “NARUTO” series. She does not have any previous reference images. The character’s name is Chiyome (チヨメ).

Character background:
Chiyome was forced to run away from home because she accidentally learned sensitive information. She is highly independent and defiant of authority. She often teases others and acts smug when her plans work. 
She is a friend to the other characters I have requested recently, but is often forced to stay separated from them since she is on the run. 

Physical traits:
- She is short. She is sometimes self-conscious of her small chest (around A-cup). She has a large butt. A similar body type is モナ(原神), example: https://files.catbox.moe/kdnc46.jpg. 
- Her skin tone is tanned, as she comes from a desert. A similar skin-tone character is 長瀞さん.
- She is 18 years old, so she is not yet fully an adult.
- Her hair is short and a little messy, similar to the attached hairstyle reference. She also has purple vertical face paint on her cheeks, since she likes to stand out. Some small amount of makeup or eyeshadow would be nice but is not required. Reference: https://files.catbox.moe/2ab53c.png. You can select any hair color you like, although I think darker colors (ex. Black, dark brown) are better, since that makes her skin seem lighter and offers more contrast. 

Clothing:
I would prefer if her outfit is practical but still highlights her attractive features. As a researcher character, her outfit would probably have small pouches and scroll tubes attached. If possible, she can wear a cloak or scarf to enhance the atmosphere of her being a lone-wolf type of character.
This is an example image where on the back of the coat of this character, there are four scroll tubes: https://files.catbox.moe/e5uvr5.jpg
She can have a forehead protector anywhere on her body, or it can be on a worktable somewhere. It is scratched out with the Sand symbol on it, shown here: https://files.catbox.moe/792l50.png.

The setting is around the 1700s, so as usual there should be no zippers or modern items.
Chiyome wears a black choker to enhance her appearance. If this conflicts with the cloak or scarf, I would prefer to keep the choker as a higher priority, since I think that will look better.

Expression: 
Her facial expression should be smug or mischievous — like she is pleased with herself after successfully manipulating someone. She is the type whose arrogance or smugness makes you want to punish her, but she is difficult to catch.

Pose & scene:
Chiyome is looking at the viewer with a smug or mischievous grin.
One hand is raised, controlling glowing chakra strings like so: https://files.catbox.moe/rjoyq9.png.
The chakra strings extend off-screen.
If possible, I would like to show some type of mannequins in the background. For example: https://files.catbox.moe/bt7rnw.png. You do not have to select these puppets –you can select any shape, design, color or size you like. They can be humanoid or inhuman. The puppets are in strange positions, their bodies twisted or bent slightly. They can have glowing blue strings attached to show that Chiyome is manipulating them.
Anywhere in the image, there is a worktable. It has an open scroll on it with sealing marks on it (ex: https://files.catbox.moe/lgrdmz.png).

Viewing Angle: 
Please select any angle which can capture the image well. I think a viewing angle from above, with Chiyome looking up at the viewer, would work best. However, it may be difficult to capture the background details that way, so please use your judgement freely and select whatever works best for you.

Atmosphere:
While Chiyome herself  is an attractive girl, the overall mood and background should feel scary, mysterious, or slightly dangerous.
Apologies for the excessive details in this request. As always, please change any details as needed to make a cool and interesting picture. Thanks for your time!

Hello,

Thank you for your previous works!

I would like to request an image of two original characters from a fan-made story based on the “NARUTO” series. Their names are Hikari (光) and Makiko (麻希子).

This picture is drawn from Kenzo’s point of view - the character from the last image, although he is not present in this picture. Both girls are looking toward the viewer, as if Kenzo is standing in front of them.

Hikari is on the left. She is a samurai who once fought Kenzo in battle. Kenzo defeated her through trickery and took her sword. Although Hikari was angry, she was also amused by Kenzo. Since then, the two sometimes flirt and share mutual respect. She often ponders Zen philosophy.

Hikari looks similar to “カルラ (Karla)” from the game “ファイアーエムブレム (Fire Emblem).” Gallery reference: https://catbox.moe/c/3ylmuz

Hikari wears a white kimono. She does not have the blue sash that カルラ has, though. In this picture, she is in her casual kimono, so armor is not necessary. She is older than Kenzo, but still a young woman. If the kimono is slightly open at the top, please show a sarashi (chest wrap) barely visible underneath. Her clothes are very clean, with no wrinkles. She often straightens her clothes when no one is looking, because she is very particular about her own appearance. As before, the setting is in the 1700s, so there should not be any zippers or modern clothing.

Her hair is black, long, and elegant. Her sword is white, with a white sheath. The sword and the sheathe have the kanji “光” written on it. The white blade might not be visible if the sword is sheathed - that is okay.

Her pose is up to you. Please choose whatever looks most natural for her cool-beauty atmosphere. She can have crossed arms, or perhaps one arm resting on her sword. 
Her expression should be serene and calm, as if she is quietly evaluating the viewer.

Makiko is the second character. She is on the right side of the image. She is Kenzo’s childhood friend and current lover. She is a village girl and does not have any combat powers. She works as a herbalist and has some civilian knowledge of nursing. She saved Kenzo's life recently when he was injured.

She is flirty, playful, and open-minded. She once told Kenzo, half-jokingly, that even if he finds other lovers in his travels, she will still be his “main wife.” She wears a woman’s samue. Her clothing colors, any accessories or design are your choice. 

Makiko has light, wavy hair. She is shorter than Hikari, but is much more curvy. She is the archetype of highly attractive, busty village girl. Her body shape is similar to the character メアリー(勝利の女神:NIKKE). Her hair is a lighter color, though. For this picture, you can select whatever hairstyle you prefer, although I think a braid is best. She has a mole on her breast, though it may not be visible in this image depending on how her clothing is placed.

She is in a teasing pose. She is leaning forward with one finger on her own lips as she looks at the viewer. You can add small herbalist details if you like, such as a small pouch or flower accessory. Alternatively, she can be leaning back and stretching to show off her body. Either pose is fine.

For the background, the girls are outdoors. They are near a mountain, with a stream, several trees, and a gravel path leading up the mountain. This is a location close to Kenzo's and Hikari's home village. Not all of this needs to be included in the image, just whatever naturally fits. 

I would like to request an alternative version where the girls are unclothed. This version is Kenzo’s imagination. The facial expressions are changed as well. Hikari has an amused or “ara-ara” expression with a light blush. Makiko is sticking her tongue out playfully as well with a seduction expression.

Please change any details as required to make a beautiful picture of two attractive but very different girls – a serene samurai and the playful village girl.

Thank you very much for your time as always!

こんにちは、ユリ！元気にしているだろうか！

今回もお願いしたいことがあるんです。今回は僕のバーチャルYouTuberのキャラクターを描いてほしいんだ。彼の名前は春藤翔で、南の海にある熱帯群島国家の大統領です。

名前は？将 治人（しょう はると）
年齢： 22歳
身長：180cm

外見
緑色の軍服を着用。緑の軍服チュニックに白いシャツ、濃い緑と茶色がかったネクタイ。肩には金色の市松模様のエポーレット。エポーレットには5つの星と鷲の記章があり、端には「TNI」の文字が外側に向けて書かれている。胸には様々なメダルが両脇に付いている。彼の名前は名札にも記されている。彼はまた5つの星がついた警棒を振っているが、今回の依頼には必要ないだろう。

構図：
夜遅くまでオフィスで働く彼を描いてほしい。彼は州の書類や文書に署名しているはずです。見る人は彼の横に立っているはずです。彼のオフィスにはランプがあり、ヴィンテージの木製家具が置かれ、背景には本棚がある。椅子の後ろには赤と白の旗があり、彼の両脇を囲んでいる。必要であれば、彼のオフィスに自由にアイテムを追加してください。

あとはあなた次第です。ありがとうございました！

Hello,

Thank you for your previous works!

I would like to request another original character for a fan-made story based on the “NARUTO” series. Her name is Momoka (モモカ).

There is no previous image of Momoka, so I cannot provide a reference picture. Instead, I will describe her physical traits.

Her teammates are Kenzo (ケンゾウ, my earlier request from 1 month ago) and Shion (シオン, another request I have submitted).

Physical traits:
Momoka is 18–19 years old.

She has red hair. Her hair is long and wavy, reaching near her lower back. She has blue eyes.

She is tall and slender. In the past, she was too thin, but she has recovered with time. Examples of girls with similar builds to Momoka are the comic book character "ポイズン・アイビー", or "フランメ" from "葬送のフリーレン". Gallery: https://catbox.moe/c/len9f7. 

She has muted, wavy burn scars from a fight in which she was badly burned. The scars cover her full body. They are not as extreme as characters like "禪院真希" from『呪術廻戦』 or "ズコー" from 『アバター 伝説の少年アン』, but they are still visible if not covered.

For this picture, please show some of the burn scars on her body. For example, they can be along her neck, shoulders, or arms. My preference is that they look artistic, not grotesque. They are a reminder of her strength and survival.

She should look like a late teenager (18–19 years old).

The setting of the series is around the 1700s. Please do not give her modern clothing. For example, no metal zippers. Traditional shinobi-style or historical clothing is preferred.

Her clothing should be practical as the priority. If it is beautiful or aesthetically attractive, that is a bonus. You can have full creative freedom for the color and design.

She should have a scratched out Rain Forehead Protector somewhere in the image. You can place it wherever is easiest to fit (forehead, neck, arm, etc). Image reference: https://files.catbox.moe/ebn9ru.png

Personality / Expression:
Momoka is calm, quiet, and thoughtful. She is very in tune with nature. She felt alone for a long time, as everyone important to her always died when she got close to them. However, she is slowly opening up to her new teammates, hoping that this time will be different.

She has endured great pain, but she hides it behind composure.

She can be warm and caring to her teammates, but often seems lost in thought, as if remembering something far away.

For this request, please give her a gentle, distant expression — calm, almost melancholic. She should look peaceful, but with subtle sadness in her eyes. She can have a neutral expression, or a faint, almost unnoticeable smile.

Pose & Equipment:

For this picture, I would like her to be relaxing with her back against a tree in a forest or mountain area, surrounded by nature. Give her a cool pose, perhaps standing with her arms crossed as she looks up at the sky. Her back is pressing into a tree. Example pose: https://files.catbox.moe/isbifj.png. You can adjust this pose to whatever looks coolest.

Momoka is an archer. She often fights with shuriken. Her main bow is heavy and made of metal. I would like to add the shuriken and metal bow into the image somewhere. She may have the shuriken in a pouch on her body, or anywhere else. The metal bow can be near Momoka, propped up against a tree. She can be holding the metal bow if you prefer a different location. Or you can add a campfire with backpacks of camping supplies, and add the metal bow there. Feel free to add the metal bow anywhere in the image where it feels natural to you.

Background / Atmosphere:
For the background, please use a natural environment such as a forest or mountain. You can choose to add a small, smoldering campfire if you'd like. It is not required.

The main background colors should be green with some brown, to contrast with the fiery forge background of Kenzo and the stormy blue background of Shion.

The atmosphere should be calm and peaceful, with a feeling of renewal after hardship. Alternatively, an atmosphere of thinking and contemplation works as well.

Thank you so much for your time as always!

Please change any details as required to make a cool and beautiful picture.

Hello,

Thank you for your previous works!

I would like to request another original character for a fan-made story based on the “NARUTO” series. Her name is Shion (シオン).

I do not have a reference picture for Shion. Instead, I will describe her physical traits.

Her teammates are a male named Kenzo (ケンゾウ) and another girl named Momoka (モモカ)

Physical traits:
Shion is 18 years old.

She has jet-black hair. Her hair is straight and about shoulder length, with slightly messy bangs in front.

She has dark brown eyes.

She is short in height. Her body type is similar to ユフィ・キサラギ (Yuffie Kisaragi) from Final Fantasy VII. She has a compact and athletic build. Please do not draw her with a very slim or model-like figure.

She should look like a late teenager (18–19 years old).

The setting of the series is around the 1700s. Please do not give her modern clothing. For example, no metal zippers. Traditional shinobi-style or historical clothing is preferred.

Her clothing should look good but also reasonably practical. For example, no exposed midriff.

You can have creative freedom for her clothing color and design. Please choose whatever looks best with the overall image.

She should have a scratched out Rain Forehead Protector somewhere in the image. You can place it wherever is easiest to fit (forehead, neck, arm, etc). Image reference: https://files.catbox.moe/ebn9ru.png

Personality / Expression:
Shion’s personality is stubborn, brash, and competitive. She is a thrill seeker who craves adrenaline rushes.

She often shows a confident grin, even while fighting. She can look like she is enjoying herself, lost in the adrenaline of combat.

For this request, please give her a cocky, confident expression. She should look like she is enjoying the fight.

Pose & Jutsu:
Shion often tries techniques beyond her limits. Sometimes these attempts fail. But when they work, the results are incredible.

Her initial main techniques are water-based. However, her main quest for growth is to learn Paper Jutsu. Her Paper Jutsu should be similar to コナン (Konan) from the NARUTO series.

She was attempting to learn Paper Jutsu, but her teachers died. She now wants to master these techniques to honor them.

For this picture, I would like to show one of her successes.

Shion is standing on a large lotus flower made of glowing paper.

Behind her, many paper talismans are floating in the air. The lotus flower and the talismans should both have a gold outline glow, to contrast with the blue background. I think blue and gold work well together. But you can change this if you think another color is better.

With one hand, she is making a ninja hand seal in front of her.

With the other hand, she is holding a whip made of water. The whip should look strong and dramatic, like a serpent of water.

Please make the scene look flashy and dramatic, as if she is showing her full power.

Background / Atmosphere:
For the background, please use a dark rainstorm sky. There should be heavy rain falling across the scene, with dark clouds overhead.

The glowing paper talismans and the water whip should stand out against the storm.

The main background color should be blue. This is to contrast with the fiery forge background of Kenzo and the natural forest background of モモカ.

Please make the atmosphere feel chaotic, dramatic, and powerful. Shion should look like she is enjoying herself in the middle of battle.

Please change any details as required to make a cool and epic picture.

Thank you so much for your time as always!

Hello,

Thank you for your previous works! 

I would like to request an image of original character for a fan-made story based on the “NARUTO” series. His name is Kenzo.

Here is a previous image of Kenzo: https://files.catbox.moe/rd3ttr.jpg

This image is from when he was younger, around 16 years old. I would like your picture to show him at an older age. For example, 18-19 years old. You do not have to keep his physical appearance consistent with the previous picture. If you want to draw him differently to make him look more cool, that is fine.

Character personality: He is serious when fighting. Outside of combat, he is confident and fun. He sometimes gets flustered easily at the teasing of some of his female companions. Examples of his common expressions can be seen in the image reference above.

The setting of the series is around the 1700s, so as before there cannot be any advanced clothing. For example, he cannot have metal zippers on his clothes. Traditional clothing is preferred. 

Important physical traits: light brown hair. Green eyes. Average height. Gymnast build. 18-19 years old. 

He has a scratched out Forehead Protector somewhere on his body. For example, around his neck, forehead, or arm (image reference: https://files.catbox.moe/ebn9ru.png )

I would like Kenzo to be in an aggressive combat stance. His weapon is "フックソード二本". Example poses include: https://catbox.moe/c/kdog8c. You can pick any pose inspired by these. Please select whatever pose you think would be simple to draw and would lead to a cool picture. You can change the pose if you like. I would like for him to have his sheathes as well.

For the background, I would like for him to be in a forge. Example: https://files.catbox.moe/estitb.png. This is because Kenzo was training to be a blacksmith in his youth, similar to his father. This changed when he discovered his ninja powers. However, he still practices his blacksmithing skills. I think this background would be a great reference to his past. As well, I would like there to be embers anywhere in the foreground to add an intense atmosphere. 

Facial expression: I would prefer a fierce or determined expression. 

Viewing angle: Up to you.

Atmosphere: Kenzo is one of the main heroes of his story, so I would like a cool, protagonist-like atmosphere. Please change any details of my request as required to make a cool picture.

Thank you so much for your time as always!

Thank you for your previous works! I would like to request an image of original characters for a fan-made story based on the “ファイアーエムブレム” series. It is a portrait image that would act like a video game cover art.

In the center of the image is the main heroine. Her name is Ryza. She is a “マムクート”, which is a unique dragon-like species in the “ファイアーエムブレム” games. “マムクート” live for thousands of years but mature very slowly. Their main weapon is the “竜石” (example: https://files.catbox.moe/88mysc.png) which allows them to transform into their dragon form. She is around 90 years old, but appears roughly 9-10 years old. Her personality is innocent, pure-hearted and determined to do what is right. She is among the few last living マムクート, excluding the final villain.

Ryza character image: https://files.catbox.moe/x76rds.jpg.

Updated clothes: If possible, I would like for her to wear a yellow cloak with a mini “capelet” (example: https://files.catbox.moe/jqy6js.jpg). The back of the cloak has decorations. The decorations are multiple golden triangles that represent mountains. However, I think the decorations would not be visible from a front viewing angle, so you do not have to draw them. The cloak does not have to have a hood. The cloak does not need to be very visible and can be behind her usual outfit. As well, the previous design has spikes as a part of her appearance. These can be removed from her arms, chest and forehead.

Pose: Ryza is looking upwards with a hopeful expression. I would prefer if her mouth is open, as if she is saying something. On the left side, her arm is at her side holding her yellow “竜石”. It is crackling with electricity. On the right side, her hand is reaching upwards. She is reaching for a larger, shimmering “竜石”. The large “竜石” glows with 5 colors: White, Yellow, Red, Green, Purple. The large stone is floating in the air on its own. Ryza is not touching it.

Ryza is guarded on her left and right side by two other characters. The atmosphere is as though the two characters are protecting her from off-screen threats that are approaching Ryza.

On the left side is Ryza’s Dragon Form. In this image, her Dragon Form can be shown separately from her humanoid form. Dragon form character image: https://files.catbox.moe/be20vo.jpg.

She is guarding Ryza’s left side and looking towards the left. Example pose: https://files.catbox.moe/ay5e2e.png. You do not need to copy that exact pose. Her Dragon form should look a little aggressive and have her mouth open as if she is roaring. Her wings are flaring out.

On the right side of the image is “Artemis”, the secondary Heroine. Her class is “弓のロード”. Character image: https://files.catbox.moe/jh8c6q.jpg. She has brown hair, green eyes, and appears 17-18 years old.

Weapon update: She is wielding a bow made of black wood. Above the grip embedded into the bow is a purple “竜石”. The bow releases several wisps of shadow or dark energy. It is her special, magical weapon. Her expression is fierce and determined. She is drawing her bow back to release an arrow at offscreen enemies on the right side of the image.

If it looks better, you can give her a green half-cloak with the hood down. However, if it’s simpler to draw her as-is, that’s fine too.

The background of the image is on a mountaintop with dark clouds above. There are Dragon Eyes at the top of the image, somewhat visible through the dark clouds. This represents the final villain, an evil dragon. The eyes are golden, with black slitted pupils (Similar to https://files.catbox.moe/141wah.png, but with gold eyes instead of red eyes). The expression of the eyes is ominous and evil.

Finally, if possible, in the dark clouds above in the far distance, I would like to add one detail to the top-left and top-right corners of the image. I would like to add three shadowed figures of dragons flying. They can be drawn in low resolution as smaller distant shapes. If the color is visible, one Dragon should be white. The second dragon is green. The third dragon is both red and black. If the color is not visible they can simply be dark shadowed shapes behind the clouds. These three dragons represent allies who help Ryza against the final villain.

I would prefer a portrait style vertical picture. Ryza, Artemis and Ryza’s Dragon form are on the bottom, surrounded by enemies that are approaching from off-screen. Far above are the dark clouds and the final villain. In between is the glowing “竜石”, although it is much closer to Ryza. If you prefer an alternate picture orientation (ex. Square, landscape), please feel free. The overall atmosphere of the picture is a heroic last stand, where a small group of heroes fights against an overwhelmingly more powerful evil foe.

Feel free to change any details as required to make a cool picture. Thank you so much for your time as always!
